english.title: Manufacturer affix a misleading marking, sign or inscription to a category F1/F2/F3 firework re UK marking
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a manufacturer, affixed to a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_
(C)_[F3]_

firework a marking, sign or inscription which was likely to mislead another person as to the meaning or form of the UK marking
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(3), 62(1)(t) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a manufacturer
affix to a cat F1/F2/F3 firework
marking / sign / inscription
which was likely to mislead as to the meaning / form of UK marking

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) does not apply (i.e. not a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is triable either way - see offence document H12298 (CJS code PA15061)
